DECLARATION OF PAYMENT

I pay the amount stated above as a security deposit pursuant to Article 8 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act Concerning the Contracting Out of Post Office Counter Operations. If it is determined that I am liable to compensate for damage arising from the contracted operation of post office counter services, I consent without objection to the use of this deposit toward payment of that compensation.
